versions.changelog: Describes HeyLead as it is today: an AI agent for LinkedIn outreach with six goals (sell, find a job, hire, partners or investors, vendors, research interviews). Voice memos are gone. Pricing is $29 per connected LinkedIn account per month. Sending runs from the cloud Monday to Friday 08:00-22:00 in your time zone. Campaigns stay drafts until you launch them.
OpenClaw integration, updated tool count to 34

HeyLead 0.9.11 Changelog

- Added detailed SKILL.md documentation, including tool descriptions, setup instructions, workflow, modes, and privacy info
- Outlined all 34 supported LinkedIn SDR tools with clear capabilities and sample usage
- Provided pricing tiers and improved onboarding steps for OpenClaw integration
- Clarified autonomous vs. copilot workflow and data privacy practices
- Updated links for PyPI, GitHub, and issue tracking
